title: Petersson-Rigid Lattices in a Census of 100 Rank-Three Root Bases
summary: The first paper worked out one family of four lattices in full -- $|\det| = 12, 24, 36$ and $72$. This paper generalizes it. We enumerate the 44 symmetrizable rank-three hyperbolic Cartan matrices and their 56 depth-one edits, 100 root bases in all, and compute the obstruction space $S_{5/2}(ρ_L)$ of the 98 within our weight-$5/2$ budget: 10 vacuous, 34 unobstructed, 54 obstructed. The vacuous ten are the lattices Bruinier, Ehlen and Freitag call simple, read in signature $(2,3)$.
